description.en: With the holy warriors

description.ja: ダ ン バ イ ン 翔 ぶ ー
description.en: Dan Bye Shobu

description.ja: 『聖戦士ダンバイン』より、
description.en: From "Sacred Warrior Dunbine"

description.ja: 主人公ショウ・ザマが駆る試験型オーラ・バトラー、
description.en: A test-type aura battler driven by the main character Shou Zama.

description.ja: “ダンバイン”が完全新規造形のＨＧシリーズで登場。
description.en: “Dunbine” is now available in the HG series with a completely new model.

description.ja: 重厚感とシャープさを両立したシルエット、生物を思わせる関節や翅など、
description.en: The silhouette is both profound and sharp, and the joints and wings are reminiscent of living creatures.

description.ja: ダンバインが有する複合的な魅力を徹底再現。
description.en: Thoroughly reproduces the complex charm of Dunbine.

description.ja: ●　完全新規造形により表現される“甲虫感”
description.en: ● “Beetle feeling” expressed by completely new modeling

description.ja: 設定画や作中のイメージを踏襲しつつ、現代の立体物としての理想を追求。
description.en: While following the setting images and images in the work, we pursue the ideal as a modern three-dimensional object.

description.ja: 曲面を多用し力強くも精悍なシルエットを再現。全身のカラーリングも現代のHG水準の分割・成形色で再現。
description.en: Reproduces a strong and fearless silhouette by making extensive use of curved surfaces. The coloring of the whole body is also reproduced with modern HG standard division and molding colors.

description.ja: 翅部分では、これまでにない生物感の表現に挑戦。
description.en: For the wing part, we attempted to express an unprecedented sense of life.

description.ja: ●　特徴的な頭部はシャープな造形と５色の成形色で再現。
description.en: ● The characteristic head is reproduced with sharp modeling and 5 molding colors.

description.ja: 斜め・側面・正面、どの角度から見ても精悍かつ劇中イメージを維持したこだわりの造形。
description.en: The model is carefully sculpted to maintain its fearless appearance from the movie, whether viewed diagonally, from the side, or from the front.

description.ja: ●　翅にはパール入りの集光樹脂を採用。有機的な造形と特殊な成形色の組み合わせにより、
description.en: ● The wings are made of light-concentrating resin containing pearls. By combining organic shapes and special molding colors,

description.ja: 見る角度によって反射・透過・光り方が変化する新たな表現を可能とした。
description.en: This enables new expressions in which reflection, transmission, and lighting change depending on the viewing angle.

description.ja: ●　胸部キャノピーには新技術“ハーフミラーメッキ”を採用。内側からは透過して外側が見えるが、
description.en: ● The chest canopy uses a new technology, “half mirror plating.” It is transparent from the inside and the outside can be seen,

description.ja: 外側からは反射して内側がみえないという、設定をイメージした表現。
description.en: An expression inspired by a setting where the inside cannot be seen because of the reflection from the outside.

description.ja: コクピット内部も細部まで再現。
description.en: The inside of the cockpit is also reproduced in detail.

description.ja: ●　複数の可動軸により様々なポージングが可能。
description.en: ● Various poses are possible with multiple movable axes.

description.ja: ●　充実の装備品 多彩なポージングが可能。
description.en: ● Full range of equipment A variety of poses are possible.

description.ja: オーラソード
description.en: aura sword

description.ja: 鞘はオーラコンバータへ懸架。
description.en: The sheath is suspended to the aura converter.

description.ja: ボール接続で、表情付けが可能。
description.en: Expressions can be added by connecting the ball.

description.ja: 足指は軸可動、足首はボールジョイントと軸可動の組み合わせにより
description.en: The toes are axially movable, and the ankles are a combination of a ball joint and axially movable.

description.ja: 独立可動を実現。
description.en: Achieves independent movement.

description.ja: ●　フルカラーパッケージでお届け
description.en: ● Delivered in full color packaging
